partialrhythm.title: Three against four — Return one kept voice without replacing the other
partialrhythm.message: partial voice Return keeps the other rhythm and inspected slot in one reversible edit

copy.rhythm-partial-return-help: Bring back just Three’s checked notes, or Four’s checked notes with its offset. The other voice and inspected slot stay put. The kept measure does not change; Undo restores the whole press.
